name: CookingCalcs
tagline: CookingCalcs offers 12 free kitchen calculators — no signup, no paywall, open and use instantly
description: CookingCalcs offers 12 free kitchen calculators — no signup, no paywall, open and use instantly. Tools included - Cups to Grams — convert over 100 ingredients by name - Oven Temperature Converter — Fahrenheit, Celsius, Gas Mark - Recipe Multiplier — scale any recipe up or down by servings - Cooking Time Calculator — by meat type, weight, and method - Meal Cost Calculator — ingredient-by-ingredient cost breakdown - Cost Per Serving — instant cost from total recipe price - Meat Temperature Guide —
